title: GTA 6 Original Score Release Date Announced with Brand New Track
description: Rockstar Games has announced the release date for the Grand Theft Auto VI Original Score, coming to streaming services, double CD, and triple vinyl, featuring a new track.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Original Score Release Date Revealed

As anticipation for Grand Theft Auto VI continues to reach unprecedented heights across the gaming community, Rockstar Games has officially announced the release details for the game's official musical accompaniment. According to IGN, the *Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score* is set to launch on **December 11**.

Fans eager to dive into the auditory atmosphere of the game will be able to access the original score across all major music streaming services starting on the release date. 

## Physical Editions for Collectors

In addition to digital streaming platforms, Rockstar Games is catering to physical media collectors and audiophiles. The original score will also be released on **double CD** and **triple vinyl** on December 11. The inclusion of a triple vinyl edition highlights the expected scale and depth of the game's musical compositions, offering a tactile way for fans to experience the score.

## Listen to the Brand New Track Now

To tide fans over until the full release in December, Rockstar Games has also released a **brand new track** available for listeners to check out right now. This new release offers a sneak peek into the sonic direction and vibe crafted for the upcoming title.

Music has always been a cornerstone of the Grand Theft Auto franchise, deeply intertwining with the open-world experience and setting the tone for every crime spree and sunset drive.

## Editor's Take

Music has always been the heartbeat of the GTA universe. By dropping a brand new track alongside clear release plans for both streaming and physical vinyl and CD editions, Rockstar Games is expertly building momentum. December 11 is shaping up to be a major date for fans who want a taste of the game's atmosphere early.
